fields.description: Appears as a selectable line on any Print Estimate's Finishing Operations table.

fields.label: Unit Basis
fields.description: How this operation is priced - per 1,000 sheets run through it, or per square metre of coverage. Choose whichever matches how your shop actually bills this finishing step.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: Price per unit (per 1,000 sheets, or per m², depending on Unit Basis above).

fields.label: Film / Foil Type
fields.description: Optional - e.g. Gloss, Matte, Gold Foil. For your own reference, doesn't affect the calculation.
